name: Omri
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Zimri reigns only seven days in Tirzah. When the people encamped against Gibbethon hear he has slain the king, they make Omri, captain of the host, king over Israel.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Israel is divided: half follow Tibni son of Ginath and half follow Omri, but Omri's followers prevail, Tibni dies, and Omri reigns.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Omri does worse than all before him, walking in the way of Jeroboam, then sleeps with his fathers, and Ahab his son reigns in his place.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Ahab son of Omri reigns twenty-two years in Samaria and does evil above all that were before him.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Ahaziah was forty and two years old when he began to reign and reigned one year in Jerusalem, and his mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

note.label: Micah 6: What Doth the Lord Require of Thee
